fields.note: The article has no dates infobox field and no closing date; the season is 34 rounds for 18 teams. Only the first round has been published — the UPL secretariat released first-round fixtures and 'The first round of the League will run up to Thursday 24th December 2026' (kawowo.com, 22 August 2026). Second-round fixtures are not out, so not even a month is known; the 05-23 default stays.
